stickers.caption: 好耶
stickers.poses: 1 crouches low anticipating jump; 2 stretches tall at takeoff arms lifting; 3 airborne with both arms high and legs tucked; 4 soft squat landing. Cheerful throughout.
stickers.layout: 好贴着左边举起的小蹄，耶在右侧小蹄上方，字与举手欢呼组成一体
stickers.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. FOUR-POSE sprite sheet, STRICT equal 2x2 quadrants. Identity reference: warm flat handmade doodle Lin Xiaoyang sheep, cream compressible cloud wool, oatmeal face, tan spiral horns, sideways ears, dot eyes, charcoal outline and small hooves. No clothing. Four complete readable stickers each with exact phrase 「好耶」 ONCE. Integrated text design: 好贴着左边举起的小蹄，耶在右侧小蹄上方，字与举手欢呼组成一体. No footer, no separate caption row. Warm chunky handmade Chinese type thin cream edge. Four distinct anatomical poses: 1 crouches low anticipating jump; 2 stretches tall at takeoff arms lifting; 3 airborne with both arms high and legs tucked; 4 soft squat landing. Cheerful throughout.. Same scale and lettering anchors across cells. Clear transparent 8% margins on each quadrant, fully transparent middle seam. No grid, no lines, no shadows or background of any color, no checkerboard. True RGBA alpha.
